summary.text: Jennifer Moore is the Republican and Conservative Party nominee for NY-10, having advanced after both June 23, 2026 primaries were canceled. The New York Post describes her as a Brooklyn Republican Party operative; she said she is running to give voters a choice after Brad Lander defeated incumbent Rep. Daniel Goldman in the Democratic primary.

sources.title: Meet the GOP hopefuls taking on Mamdani-endorsed NY House Dems
